plan-for-creating-registries-on-shared-s.text: Plan for creating registries on shared script publications.

Issue 745. This page is for the people who implement and review the pull requests. It binds the model, the rulings, the pull requests and their slices, the consumers a slice can break and the seats. The story and the requirements are in the specification; the checks are in the gate.

what-already-exists-on-main.text: Issue 742 shipped the publication library (Singular.State.Publication): the first registry of an application publishes the state script and the application script, each in a transaction of its own; a later registry finds the live copies by script hash and sends the creation alone. Its devnet journey already records a creation measurement of three transactions for the first registry and one for a later one. This ticket does not rebuild that. It owes what the issue still asks for and the journey does not show:
a matched baseline against the previous design, with every transaction, reference output, script size, fee and locked.
explicit, receipted outcomes for a missing, spent or wrong reference, and for another application policy or release;.
the measured attempt to carry a script in the creation transaction;.
reuse by a creator who never published and holds no file of an earlier creator;.
a registry created on live copies completing a registration;.
the instructions and the receipt-computed conformance rows for all of it.

lean-binding.text: Lean is the authority. This ticket adds no Lean statement and changes no on-chain script, hash or wire format. Creation stays bound to the statements issue 742 implements: genesis_inversion, recognition_inversion and the create_journey money statement of the Singular family, and configurationCreate_inversion and configuration_immutable of the open-datum family (Lake projects models/singular-application-held and models/open-datum-application-held). If a measurement shows a statement cannot be met, or a requirement here needs a statement the models lack, the ticket owner files a question with a user story before work on that line continues.

rulings-in-force.text: Registry identity is the state policy and the state token name (issue 741 decisions). The state script is the state.
validator applied to the application's policy; the application script takes no registry parameter.
The request lifecycle belongs to the application (23 October 2026): no per-registry request script exists on this line.
Roles (issue 767, 28 October 2026): folders and readers are application-neutral; creators and key holders may use the.
application's program. This ticket adds no per-application code to a neutral role.
The provider is the chain entry point (20 October 2026): every chain read goes through the session; a creator works.
from a web page, Koios and a wallet, with no local file of another creator.
Versioning: stay 0.x; no script hash changes in this ticket.
Wallets for any preprod work live in ~/.local/share/singular-demo/preprod/; the default network is the development.
The trie library's proofs are assumed sound.

pull-requests-and-slices.text: Each slice finishes in well under two hours with its own RED evidence and checkpoints; the commit owner may cut a slice smaller, never merge two. If the carrying attempt fits and is adopted, the change of the creation transaction is a fourth pull request and the ticket owner asks the epic owner first, because the receipt shape is shared with issues 743 to 746.

seats.text: A ticket owner, a commit owner and a commit auditor, as the operator agreed on 29 October 2026. The auditor is persistent and mute, and answers each checkpoint through the ticket owner. No other seat. A stalled seat is reported; no other model takes its place.
